verdict.rationale: The pack documents no first-party feature for setting up recurring or background automations, such as scheduled transfers, rules-based workflows or autonomous agent jobs. Webhooks, APIs, SDKs, the CLI and the AgentOS toolkit are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own automations, which earns no credit here. The spend overview's 'automate' wording is a generic marketing phrase with no documented configurable automation behind it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
